v1.14.0 development plan. PHASED, dataset-driven, theme E (Guardrails / data hygiene) selected 2026-05-05. #99 shipped 2026-05-05; remaining theme E candidates open.

UPDATE 2026-05-05: Phase 1 soak ran 12 days (Apr 23 → May 5). Mid-soak dataset analysis (audit/telemetry from 2 machines) surfaced strong signal pointing at a fifth theme not in the original four. Soak-only discipline relaxed because evidence is unambiguous. See docs/investigation-bootstrap-overflow-2026-05-05.md + docs/dataset-2026-05-05-findings.md. Soak-exit policy codified same day from the calibration sample, see project.soakPolicy.

PHASE 1 — SOAK (2026-04-23 → 2026-05-05, 12 days, exited early on data clarity per project.soakPolicy)
Original signals to watch (still relevant for Phase 2):
- Empty-codex_get rate drops from 48% baseline (#92 core acceptance).
- aliasResolved reliably captured on codex_run + codex_copy (#93/#94).
- context.next_session picks up organic use (#91 adoption signal).
- Seed-quality lint holds 0 false-positives (#82).
- Topology pair counts emerge past zero (#83).

PHASE 2 — THEME PICK (decided 2026-05-05, day 12 of soak)

Original four themes (still valid framing):
  A. Metadata maturity — #45, #84, #42
  B. Search / discoverability — #13, #43
  C. Distribution — #6, #49, #50, #51
  D. Polish / performance — #44, #47, #48

PICKED: theme E added 2026-05-05 from soak findings:
  E. Guardrails / data hygiene — #99 SHIPPED via PR #104 (project-resolution refusal, root-cause anchor), #100 (codex_context size budget), #101 (write-amp guard), #102 (audit project=. logging bug, small), #103 (tier semantics docs), pairs with #84 (entry health) already in milestone.

Why E was picked: the dataset shows the FA-iOS bootstrap-overflow incident is two stacked causes (silent project-resolution fallthrough + 4-7x write amplification on files.* keys). Same pattern reproduced on machine 02's CAS_robot store (well-tended, still hit cap edge). Miss-paths writeback rate 3.7% — the existing feedback loop is broken. These are correctness/UX bugs in production, not feature wishes.

Dataset bias rules (still apply for future cycles):
- Metadata conversations → A.
- Agents struggling to locate entries → B.
- New-user onboarding pain → C.
- Response-time complaints → D.
- Bootstrap overflow / silent data routing failures → E. ← THE SIGNAL v1.14 GOT.

Pick the theme anchor + ≤5 issues total. Trim rest to v1.15 backlog (unmilestone).

PHASE 3 — DESIGN + BUILD (in progress)
#99 SHIPPED 2026-05-05 via PR #104 (merge d9126b4). Design doc: docs/design-99-project-resolution-refusal.md. Implementation bundled in one PR (chokepoint + 11 entry points + MCP wire format + telemetry fields + tests + CHANGELOG + LLM_INSTRUCTIONS). Two follow-up commits during review addressed cache fix, diagnostic split, dead-code removal, and test coverage gaps.

REMAINING:
- #100 (codex_context size budget): needs a budget-default conversation. What's the cap, what tier do we degrade to, do we warn or hard-cut?
- #101 (write-amp guard): needs a warning-vs-blocking decision. Same-key Nx writes per session — surface as a stats line, a one-time warning, or a hard refusal?
- #102 (audit project=. logging bug): small, ship-anytime. Audit records "." instead of resolved cwd in some paths.
- #103 (tier semantics docs): small, ship-anytime. Document essential/standard/full tier behavior.

PHASE 4 — CI / INDIE ITEMS
#96 shipped via PR #98 on 2026-04-28 — Phase 4 is empty.

RELEASE TARGET
No calendar date yet. With #99 shipped and remaining theme E items being smaller, v1.14.0 could ship faster than the 4-6 week original estimate. Don't over-commit — let #100/#101 design pace set the cadence.

DOGFOODING PART THREE
Expected alongside v1.14.0 tag. With theme E, the narrative is "the loop closed and showed us a hole" (#99) + "we codified the soak policy from the same data" (project.soakPolicy). Both grew out of the dataset mine.

SOAK POLICY CALIBRATION
v1.14 is the N=1 calibration sample for project.soakPolicy. Single-machine 7d snapshot at exit: 16 sessions, 281 calls, 7 namespaces, 4 projects — clears the gate (>=10 sessions, >=5 namespaces, >=3 projects, >=7 elapsed days). Cross-machine aggregate was the actual signal source; the gate was set to be conservative on a single machine. Refine with v1.15.

ANTI-PATTERN WARNINGS
- Don't pre-commit to a theme before Phase 1 data. ← Honored.
- Don't let the candidate list sprawl past 5 shipped items.
- Don't skip the design pass on a behavior-changing surface — silent-fallthrough refusal needed the design-first treatment, and PR #104 was the result.
- Don't re-audit the bootstrap-overflow area without a new finding (issues #99-103 fully cover it as currently understood).
- Don't soak past 14 days even on thin signal (project.soakPolicy).
